name: Downloads
description: One row per asset: an image cell, a title cell, and a links cell whose link texts are the sizes (Original, 1920px; PDF, MP4). Optional date cell (d. m. yyyy). Optional settings rows first: collapse (auto / none), columns (a whole number). A bad collapse or columns value stops the block.

visualCharacteristics.purpose: downloadable assets with sizes and add-to-media-cart

options.label: media-box
options.description: The Media Box at the end of a story, release or press-kit chapter: titles as headings, dates, size menu, "Show more" after two rows, lightbox on the images. Put it in a section with Style "dark, full-width, media-box" and an h2 "Media Box".

options.label: gallery
options.description: Press-kit Images chapter group: thumbnails with add / download over the image and the "Original / 1920px" pills above the group.
